Name: DarkStrata Ghost
Author: DarkStrata - support@darkstrata.io
Description:
The [DarkStrata](https://darkstrata.io) Ghost solution brings DarkStrata Ghost (honeytoken) events into Microsoft Sentinel. A ghost is a decoy identity that exists only to be stolen: when DarkStrata finds one in a stealer log, breach or combolist, the solution raises a high-fidelity alert tagged with MITRE ATT&CK. It also alerts when a ghost is retired (a tamper alarm) and ships templates for domain controller honey-account detections.

**Underlying Microsoft Technologies used:**

This solution takes a dependency on the following technologies, and some of these dependencies either may be in [Preview](https://azure.microsoft.com/support/legal/preview-supplemental-terms/) state or might result in additional ingestion or operational costs:

 a. [Codeless Connector Framework](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/sentinel/create-codeless-connector)

 b. [Azure Monitor Logs Ingestion API and data collection rules](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-monitor/logs/logs-ingestion-api-overview)
